Heavy rains have flooded tens of thousands of tents in Gaza, and a baby has died from cold. Kosovo fans booed and whistled the Israeli national anthem before a Nations League draw. The European Union called for immediate, unimpeded humanitarian aid to Gaza amid the flooding, and the United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

The Houthis also stepped up missile strikes on Saudi Arabia, targeting Riyadh and other sites, while Saudi air defenses intercepted several missiles and a drone over eastern Saudi territory.
